scientific_question: For the specified cyclopentenone-, cyclohexenone-, and phenylsulfonyl-bearing electron-deficient [3]dendralenes reacting with methanethiolate in chloroform, which addition sites and protonated product connectivities are favored, what controls the accessibility of simple-addition versus cyclized outcomes for the cyclic-enone pair, and how robust are those selectivity conclusions? Include whether a second thiol addition is competitive for the cyclopentenone-bearing substrate.

inputs.content: Cyclopentenone-bearing substrate: dimethyl (2Z,4E)-3-(5-oxocyclopent-1-en-1-yl)hexa-2,4-dienedioate, molecular formula C13H14O5. Its connectivity is MeO-C(=O)-CH=C(R)-CH=CH-C(=O)-OMe, with R = 5-oxocyclopent-1-en-1-yl (ring connectivity C1=CH-CH2-CH2-C(=O)-1, attached to the dienoate through the first ring carbon). The parent dienoate double bonds are 2Z and 4E. No absolute axial configuration is specified.

Cyclohexenone-bearing substrate: dimethyl (2Z,4E)-3-(6-oxocyclohex-1-en-1-yl)hexa-2,4-dienedioate, molecular formula C14H16O5. Its connectivity is MeO-C(=O)-CH=C(R)-CH=CH-C(=O)-OMe, with R = 6-oxocyclohex-1-en-1-yl (ring connectivity C1=CH-CH2-CH2-CH2-C(=O)-1, attached to the dienoate through the first ring carbon). The parent dienoate double bonds are 2Z and 4E. No absolute axial configuration is specified.

Phenylsulfonyl-bearing substrate: dimethyl (2Z,4E)-3-((E)-1-phenyl-2-(phenylsulfonyl)vinyl)hexa-2,4-dienedioate, molecular formula C22H20O6S. Its connectivity is MeO-C(=O)-CH=C(R)-CH=CH-C(=O)-OMe, with R = C(Ph)=CH-S(=O)2-Ph, attached through C(Ph); Ph denotes phenyl and Me denotes methyl. The parent dienoate double bonds are 2Z and 4E. On the appendage double bond the dienoate substituent and S(=O)2-Ph are on opposite sides; Ph and S(=O)2-Ph are on the same side. Use this specified appendage isomer, not an unspecified E/Z mixture. No absolute axial configuration is specified.

The nucleophilic reaction partner is methanethiolate, CH3S-, with formal charge -1 (SMILES C[S-]). Methanethiol, CH3SH (SMILES CS), is the corresponding neutral thiol. Comparisons involving protonation or different addition stoichiometries must use balanced reactions and explicitly declared proton/thiol reference reservoirs; no particular proton-transfer mechanism or counterion identity is supplied.

The comparison boundary is chloroform solution at 298.15 K using a 1 M solution standard-state convention. The standard-state convention is not a specified experimental reactant concentration. State the solvent representation and other model assumptions used in your work.

changes.reason: Organize the same three-system author investigation beyond the frozen thermodynamic/intermediate-comparison framing: retain site and protonated-product comparisons, explicitly restore pathway accessibility and simple-versus-cyclic competition (CR2, CR3, CR5), PI1 further-addition competition (CR1 and Figure S8), and model-dependent uncertainty (CR1 and main conclusion). The review inventory maps reactant geometries/Fukui tests, trial additions/protonation products, scans/TSs/cyclizations, PI1 second additions, IBO interpretation, and multiple-method/DLPNO comparisons to one scientific question. Neutralize the mandatory intermediate-comparison instruction into a scientific outcome; do not require a descriptor or author route. No chemical system, original reference record, result, experimental input, or uncomputed reaction is substituted. PI2/PI3 second additions and experimental hydride/base/iodine processes remain out of scope.

Clarify the actual five-membered-enone molecular graph, both methyl ester termini, attachment-adjacent 5-oxo position and parent 2Z,4E stereochemistry from SI structure/precursor and R5_0_1 coordinates. The frozen generic identity is not replaced with another substrate; no optimized geometry or absolute axial configuration is disclosed.

Clarify the actual six-membered-enone molecular graph, both methyl ester termini, attachment-adjacent 6-oxo position and parent 2Z,4E stereochemistry from SI structure/precursor and R6_0_1 coordinates. The frozen generic identity is not replaced with another substrate; no optimized geometry or absolute axial configuration is disclosed.

Clarify the full vinylsulfone graph, including the phenyl group attached to the vinyl carbon as well as the separate phenylsulfonyl group, methyl ester termini, parent 2Z,4E stereochemistry and specified E appendage. Original SI structure/precursor and Sulf_0_1 coordinates agree. The source preparation included an E/Z mixture, but the computed reference parent graph is the explicitly verified E isomer; the graph-explicit input does not silently substitute a different substrate or optimized conformer.

Retain the specified methanethiolate partner while withholding the author cost-saving/model-selection history. Identify its corresponding neutral thiol solely to make balanced comparisons of protonated mono-/second-addition products startable. The Figure S8 reference definitions use MeS- for anions and MeSH for neutral products; no proton-transfer mechanism or unreported counterion is prescribed.

Keep chloroform, 298.15 K, and the 1 M solution standard state exactly. Withhold the DFT/implicit-solvation recipe and reported-energy framing so the solver chooses models. Clarify that standard-state normalization is not an experimental concentration; no conditions are changed.

scoring_requirements: 现行计分完全由scoring_rules.json的13项二元科学结果决定，共100分。研究过程、假设/检验数、工具软件序列、资源投入、报告文风、一般失败诊断、通用局限性均无独立分；真实产物、身份、参照和主张对应验证是科学结果成立的前提。公开任务及非评分作者资料原样保留。
